$comment: Chiba Tech design rules, machine-checkable. The editor, tools, and build lint enforce these. Blocked by a rule you disagree with? Edit this file — that is the intended escape hatch: an explicit, named, reviewable decision (git will attribute it to you). Prose rationale lives in GUIDANCE.md. Decks may override specific rules or extend tokens in their own CSS (deck-scoped variants are first-class, not violations).
